RTL module:
```verilog
module comparator(
    input [3:0] A,
    input [3:0] B,
    output reg [1:0] C
);

// Comparing A and B
always @(*) begin
    if(A == B) begin
        C = 2'b00;
    end
    else if(A > B) begin
        C = 2'b01;
    end
    else begin
        C = 2'b10;
    end
end

endmodule
```

    input [3:0] A,
    input [3:0] B,
    input ctrl,
    output reg [3:0] Y
);

    always @(*) begin
        if (ctrl) begin
            Y <= A + B;
        end else begin
            Y <= A - B;
        end
    end

module modulo_operator (
  input [31:0] div,
  input [31:0] divisor,
  output reg [31:0] rem
);

always @(*) begin

  end else begin

end
